integrity: Proof is analytic, not based on an exhaustive norm search. Standalone code tests four explicitly specified norm models.
scientific_limitations: Only normalized coordinatewise-monotone absolute norms, finite metric spaces, and vertex-witness closed-ball Čech complexes. General categorical product Künneth behavior is prior work; the new content is necessity and four-point obstruction. Novelty comparison may be incomplete.
title: Maximum-norm rigidity for vertex-witness Čech product persistence
